title: External test of the frozen ND-06 depression rule against wild-type paired-pulse and train recordings from a laboratory that contributed nothing to its parameters
status: EXECUTED 2026-09-09 in two stages. H1 failed, H2 passed uninformatively, H3 failed. The wild-type paired-pulse arrays of Figure 3D are open; every other reserved file in the corpus is still sealed.

why_this_exists.the_open_prediction: The plasticity registry has carried an open prediction since commit fb01944: the second-to-first unitary EPSC amplitude ratio at a 100 ms interval is 0.8033, with the recorded status that it 'becomes a test only against a paired-pulse or train recording not used by Nagel and colleagues'. Rozenfeld and colleagues 2023 measured exactly that, at five intervals including 100 ms, in a laboratory that contributed nothing to the registered parameters. The prediction was committed before those files were staged in commit a24249f, so it is blind by commit ordering rather than by assertion.
why_this_exists.the_one_existing_external_test_failed: The rule's only prior external test failed: against Kazama and Wilson's 7 Hz measurement it over-predicts steady-state depression by about 16 percentage points. No parameter was changed on that basis, because refitting to the only external check would have destroyed it. This contract is the second external test, and it is registered with the same rule: nothing is refitted on the outcome.
why_this_exists.what_it_is_not: It is NOT a reinstatement of the retired synaptic leg. That leg requires raw unitary EPSC traces from a preparation not used to fit the kernel, and these recordings are compound evoked responses, so the leg stays retired and the Stage 2 exit gate stays at v4 and 0 of 3. See ADR-2026-012.

the_model_and_what_it_can_generate.family: depression-only Tsodyks-Markram, one resource variable, from configs/neural/short-term-plasticity-v0.1.json rule orn-to-uniglomerular-pn

closed_forms.train_steady_state: (1 - c) / (1 - (1 - U) c) with c = exp(-dt/tau)

predicted_observables: the ratio of a second evoked response to a first, at a stated interval, from rest
the amplitude of the nth response of a regular train, normalised to the first

observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.rule: An observable is scored only if the frozen model generates it. Adding one because the dataset contains it turns a test into a choice of what to report.
observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.response_latency: Reserved and not scored. ND-06 has no latency term; ND-05 carries conduction and release latency as a policy with no fitted value for this preparation, and the stimulating-electrode distance is unknown, so no number can be generated. The dataset's mean_rise_time arrays are labelled eEPSC latency in the authors' own plotting code.
observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.latency_jitter: Reserved and not scored. Jitter requires the stochastic-release class; the registered baseline is static-deterministic and predicts exactly zero, which is degenerate rather than testable.
observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.miniature_epsc_amplitude_and_frequency: Reserved and not scored. No quantal amplitude and no spontaneous release rate is registered.
observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.evoked_amplitude_in_picoamps: Reserved and not scored. ND-04 is contact count times a type-pair scale with contact_count_is_strength false, so there is no absolute conductance to convert into picoamps.
observables_the_dataset_supplies_and_the.bruchpilot_puncta: Reserved and not scored here. A light-microscopy puncta count and an electron-microscopy contact count are not the same unit, and the identification of the two is itself under test, so it cannot be assumed in order to score it. It needs its own contract.

prediction_grid.pulse_counts_come_from: the array widths recorded in the reservation manifest, which are metadata; no value was read to obtain them
prediction_grid.prediction_band: The envelope over the three published fits taken as pairs. A utilisation from one pharmacological component with a recovery constant from another describes no measurement, so the band is three points in parameter space rather than the corners of a rectangle over the two ranges. For this particular family the distinction makes no numerical difference, because the utilisation and the recovery constant increase together across the three fits, so the extreme rectangle corners happen to be real pairs. The pairing is still what is computed, because a later revision need not be co-monotone and because a mixed pair would be a parameter set nobody measured.

primary_source.why_control_only: The wild-type control is the baseline a wild-type model predicts. The RNAi arrays are a cacophony calcium-channel knockdown, which changes release probability by design, so they are a manipulation and secondary.

secondary_source.unit_of_observation: one amplitude series per animal across the train

preregistered_replications.variables: the same five _control arrays in each
preregistered_replications.rule: All three cohorts are opened in the same single pass and all three are reported. The primary verdict is set by Fig3D alone, named here before anything is opened, so a cohort cannot be promoted to primary after the fact. The other two are consistency checks and cannot rescue or overturn the primary.
preregistered_replications.why_this_matters: Three independent control cohorts measuring the same quantity is an opportunity to shop for the agreeable one. Fixing the primary and reporting all three is what removes that opportunity.

sealed_and_not_opened_by_this_contract: rozenfeld2023-repo/Figure 6/Fig6D.mat, which is a day-0 versus later-day comparison; ageing is a manipulation the registered model has no parameter for
rozenfeld2023-repo/Figure 1/Fig1H.mat and Fig1I.mat, the odour-evoked traces
rozenfeld2023-repo/Figure 3/Fig3B.mat, Fig3G.mat and Fig3I.mat, absolute amplitudes
rozenfeld2023-repo/Figure 5/Fig5B.mat and Fig5D.mat, minis and Bruchpilot puncta

observation_model.paired_pulse: The measured amplitude ratio is taken to equal the model's resource ratio. Each animal contributes one ratio and the cohort mean is compared to the prediction.
observation_model.train_normalisation_fixed_now: Per animal, the steady state is the mean of the final ten pulses divided by the first pulse. This convention is fixed before the values are opened; choosing it afterwards would be a free parameter worth several tenths at 60 Hz.
observation_model.nan_handling_fixed_now: The authors' own scripts use nanmean, so the arrays contain missing entries. A missing first pulse voids that animal; missing entries inside the final ten are skipped; an animal with fewer than five of the final ten present is excluded and the exclusion count is reported.
observation_model.known_biases_and_why_the_direction_is_no: Not one-sided, and the first version of this contract wrongly said they were. Postsynaptic receptor saturation raises a measured ratio, because the transfer from released vesicles to current is concave and the larger first response is compressed more than the smaller second one. Receptor desensitisation lowers it. Recruitment can do either: axons that fail to fire again lower the ratio, stimulus-dependent excitability changes can raise it, and variable recruitment adds variance without a sign. The withdrawn claim was that a measured ratio ABOVE the prediction could not be explained by observation error; saturation explains exactly that, so the claim is gone and no direction of disagreement is privileged. What remains is that all of these effects shrink with interval.

hypotheses.name: the registered prediction at the interval it was registered for
hypotheses.statement: The wild-type mean paired-pulse ratio at 100 ms contains the registered prediction of 0.8033 in its 95 percent confidence interval.
hypotheses.why_blind: The number 0.8033 was committed at fb01944, before the Rozenfeld files were staged at a24249f. Neither the value nor the interval was chosen with any knowledge of this dataset.
hypotheses.criterion: The Student-t 95 percent confidence interval of the per-animal mean, over about 22 animals, contains 0.8033.
hypotheses.degenerate_outcome_check: A wide interval passes this trivially. If the 95 percent half-width exceeds 0.10, H1 is scored as NO VERDICT rather than passed, and the half-width is reported either way. This is the check that the equivalent Track A criterion needed and did not originally have.
hypotheses.why_100_ms_is_the_primary: Reduced response overlap, not a one-sided bias. At 10 and 30 ms the second response rises from the decaying tail of the first, so the measured second amplitude depends on a baseline convention that the authors' code does not state, and the estimate can be biased either way by that choice alone. At 100 ms a nicotinic ORN-to-PN EPSC has largely returned to baseline, so the second amplitude is measured from near rest and the convention barely matters. Receptor occupancy has also recovered further than at the two shorter intervals. The interval was in any case not chosen here: it is the one the registry's open prediction was written for at commit fb01944.

hypotheses.name: the floor the model cannot go below
hypotheses.statement: No wild-type mean paired-pulse ratio, at any of the five intervals, lies below 0.7700.
hypotheses.criterion: The ratio is 1 - U exp(-dt/tau), which approaches 1 - U as the interval shrinks. Across the three published fits the smallest attainable value is 1 - 0.23 = 0.7700. A measured cohort mean below that refutes the rule as registered, at every member of its parameter family, with no threshold chosen by this contract.
hypotheses.why_this_is_the_sharpest_test: It is a bound rather than an interval, so it cannot be passed for lack of power and this contract chooses no threshold to set it: the number follows from 1 - U across the registered family. It is also the criterion most likely to fail, which is why it is registered rather than omitted. What it is not is immune to observation error. It is immune to the one bias that inflates a ratio, since saturation cannot push a measurement below the floor, and it is not immune to desensitisation or to recruitment failure.
hypotheses.confound_disclosed: A cohort mean below the floor refutes the rule as registered, and it does not on its own say which term is wrong. Saturation would push a measured ratio up and therefore cannot produce a failure of this floor; desensitisation and recruitment failure both can. So a failure here is attributable to the registered single-resource rule or to the postsynaptic and presynaptic terms of VAL-02, in an unknown mixture, and the mixture is least favourable at 10 and 30 ms. At 300 and 1000 ms the observation terms are smallest and a failure would bear most directly on the rule.

hypotheses.name: recovery is monotone in interval
hypotheses.statement: The five wild-type mean ratios are non-decreasing from 10 ms to 1000 ms.
hypotheses.criterion: The five cohort means, in interval order, are non-decreasing.
hypotheses.weakness_disclosed: Any single recovery process produces this, so passing is weak evidence. The chance of the exact ordering under random permutation is 1 in 120, which is the whole of its strength. It is registered as a necessary condition and as a check that the arrays are what their names say.

hypotheses.name: the train the parameters were fitted from, at frequencies they were not
hypotheses.statement: The wild-type steady-state depression at 1, 10, 20 and 60 Hz contains the primary fit's exact discrete prediction at each frequency.
hypotheses.criterion: At each frequency the Student-t 95 percent confidence interval of the per-animal steady state, computed under the normalisation fixed above, contains the prediction. Reported per frequency; four independent verdicts, not one composite.
hypotheses.why_it_adds_to_H1: The registered parameters come from a 10 Hz train fit, so the 10 Hz frequency is close to the fit and 1, 20 and 60 Hz are not. A model that gets 10 Hz right and 60 Hz wrong is reporting the range over which one resource variable can stand in for the two components Nagel and colleagues measured pharmacologically.
hypotheses.degenerate_outcome_check: Same half-width rule as H1, applied per frequency.

hypotheses.name: the perturbation direction, secondary
hypotheses.statement: Reducing presynaptic calcium-channel expression raises the paired-pulse ratio at every interval relative to control.
hypotheses.criterion: The RNAi cohort mean exceeds the control cohort mean at each of the five intervals. Direction only; no magnitude is predicted.
hypotheses.why_only_direction: The registered model has no cacophony-knockdown parameterisation, so no utilisation can be assigned to the manipulation. What the Tsodyks-Markram form does predict is the sign: lower release probability means less depletion by the first pulse, so a higher ratio. That tests the form, not the parameters.
hypotheses.why_secondary: A wild-type model is tested against a wild-type baseline. The perturbation cohort is reported because a form that gets the sign wrong is refuted regardless, not because it could award anything.

expected_outcome_stated_before_the_run.prediction: H2 is expected to FAIL, and it is the most likely failure. Kazama and Wilson's variance-derived release probability of 0.79 at this synapse, which the registry records as the competing reading, implies paired-pulse depression far deeper than a utilisation of 0.22 permits. Receptor desensitisation and recruitment failure would deepen the measurement further; receptor saturation would work against the prediction of failure, which is part of why the expectation is stated as a probability rather than a certainty.
expected_outcome_stated_before_the_run.what_a_joint_outcome_would_mean: The existing 7 Hz test says the rule OVER-predicts steady-state depression. If this test says it UNDER-predicts paired-pulse depression, the pattern is a synapse that depresses faster than the rule and settles higher than it, which no single exponential resource can produce. The candidate explanation is the one-resource collapse of a two-component response, which this registry's claim boundary already names and whose components Nagel and colleagues published separately. It is a candidate and not a conclusion: because the observation biases run in both directions, a two-sided discrepancy can also be produced by saturation at one interval and desensitisation at another, and separating the two readings needs the saturation control VAL-02 names as unregistered.
expected_outcome_stated_before_the_run.why_this_is_written_down: So that the outcome cannot be presented as a surprise in either direction, and so that the candidate diagnosis and its limits are fixed before the data can suggest one.

acceptance.what_a_pass_would_establish: That a depression rule whose parameters were taken from one laboratory's 10 Hz fit predicts another laboratory's paired-pulse and train measurements at intervals spanning two orders of magnitude. That is the first genuinely external quantitative agreement any dynamical parameter in this project would have.
acceptance.what_a_pass_would_not_establish: No tier, and not the retired synaptic leg. The recordings are compound evoked responses through an observation model that is itself an assumption, and the synapse measured is in a different specimen and a different sex from MaleCNS.
acceptance.what_a_failure_would_establish: That the registered single-resource depression rule, as parameterised, does not predict compound evoked ORN-to-PN paired-pulse and train ratios under the VAL-02 observation model. That is narrower than it sounds and the narrowing is deliberate: it is NOT a falsification of presynaptic vesicle depletion as the mechanism. The depletion form has independent support at this synapse that this test does not touch, in Kazama and Wilson's finding that 7 Hz stimulation decreases 1 over CV squared in step with the uEPSC amplitude decrease at Pearson r = 0.79, which locates the depression presynaptically. A failure here bears on the parameters, on the collapse of two measured components onto one resource variable, and on the observation model, and it cannot distinguish among those three without the controls VAL-02 names as unregistered.
acceptance.no_refitting: No parameter is changed on this outcome. That is the rule the 7 Hz failure was recorded under and it holds here: refitting to an external test converts the only external check into a training set. A revision may be issued as a new registry version with its own predictions, and it must not claim this test as evidence.
acceptance.no_criterion_may_be_restated: If a criterion fails it is reported failed. The project has had to reissue a criterion once already for being satisfiable by a degenerate outcome, and the rule since then is that a failed criterion is never rewritten after the fact.

execution_order: 1. Commit this contract and the prediction artifact it generates, with the reserved values unopened.
2. Confirm the reservation manifest records the two source files with the checksums the run will read.
3. Open only the named _control and _RNAi arrays in Fig3D, Fig3E_and_F, Fig3H and Fig3J, in one pass.
4. Score H1 to H5 exactly as written and report every verdict, including NO VERDICT outcomes.
5. Leave every other reserved file sealed.
claim_boundary: Design and predictions only. Nothing is opened, nothing is scored, no artifact of a measurement is produced, and no tier is awarded by this contract.

amendment.what_changed: The observation-model bias account, and every inference that rested on it. The first version said receptor saturation, desensitisation and recruitment failure all deepen a measured paired-pulse ratio, and concluded that a measured ratio above the prediction could not be explained by observation error. Saturation does the opposite: it inflates the ratio, because the concave transfer from released vesicles to current compresses the larger first response more than the smaller second one. Recruitment has no safe direction either.
amendment.why_it_mattered: The withdrawn claim would have licensed reading a high measured ratio as agreement with the model while attributing a low one to the observation. That is a one-directional escape hatch, and it is the same shape as the criterion drift this project has had to repair before.
amendment.what_did_not_change: No numeric prediction, no criterion and no threshold. The 100 ms primary stays primary and its interval was never chosen here; what changed is its justification, which is now reduced response overlap rather than a one-sided bias. The floor of 0.7700 is unchanged. What narrowed is the inference drawn from failing it.
amendment.withdrawn_text_preserved: Receptor saturation, receptor desensitisation and presynaptic recruitment failure all deepen a measured ratio relative to vesicle depletion alone, so all three bias the measurement downward against the prediction. A measured ratio ABOVE the prediction therefore cannot be explained by any of them.

execution_record.cleanliness_established_by: the byte-level audit, not git status
execution_record.why_that_sha_no_longer_matches_this_file: The artifacts pinned this contract as it stood at the moment the values were opened, which is the state that matters. This execution record and the corrections below were written afterwards, so the file's digest has moved on. The pre-execution digest is recorded here so the pinning still checks out.

results.H1: FAILED. 100 ms cohort mean 1.0286, 95 percent interval [0.9474, 1.1099] over 22 animals, against the registered prediction 0.8033. The half-width is 0.0812, inside the registered 0.10 limit, so this is a failure and not a NO VERDICT.
results.H2: PASSED, and the pass is uninformative. No cohort mean lies below the 0.7700 floor because every mean lies far ABOVE it. A floor test passes trivially when the measurement is nowhere near the floor.
results.H3: FAILED, and this is the informative one. The cohort means DECREASE with interval: 1.5139, 1.1583, 1.0286, 0.9299, 0.9302 at 10, 30, 100, 300 and 1000 ms. The registered rule predicts a monotone increase at every parameter setting.
results.H4: not scored; the train arrays were not opened.
results.H5: not scored; the RNAi arrays were not opened.

execution_record.no_animal_was_excluded: Every array was complete: 20, 21, 22, 22 and 22 finite values with no non-finite entries, so the addendum missing-data rule never had to be applied.
execution_record.the_one_agreement_is_the_least_informati: 1000 ms is the only interval whose interval contains the prediction, and it is where the model asymptotes toward 1 and is therefore least distinguishable from any other account. The observed means at 300 and 1000 ms are 0.9299 and 0.9302, a plateau, while the prediction is still rising through 0.8428 to 0.9282. The curves cross there. Banking that as a success would be reading a coincidence as a prediction.
execution_record.what_this_establishes: The registered depression-only single-resource rule does not predict this synapse's paired-pulse behaviour, and no parameter setting could. PPR = 1 - U exp(-dt/tau) is at most 1 and increases with interval at every U and tau. The measurements exceed 1 at three of five intervals and decrease throughout. That is a refutation of the registered model FAMILY on this observable, not a parameter miss, which is also why the no-refitting rule costs nothing here: refitting cannot rescue it.
execution_record.what_this_does_not_establish: It does not falsify presynaptic vesicle depletion. Facilitation and depletion coexist routinely, and the registered rule is depression-only BY CONSTRUCTION: the registry records its family as tsodyks-markram-depression-only while naming stochastic-release-and-STP as the supported class. Nagel and colleagues fitted their parameters to a 10 Hz train, where depression dominates from the fifth pulse onward and an early facilitation term is nearly invisible. So the diagnosis is a MISSING mechanism rather than a wrong one, and the depletion form keeps the independent support this test never touched: Kazama and Wilson's 1 over CV squared decrease correlating with the amplitude decrease at r = 0.79.
execution_record.no_refitting_performed: The utilisation stays 0.22 and the recovery time constant stays 893 ms. No parameter was adjusted before, during or after scoring, and no revision may claim this test as evidence for its values.

post_execution_corrections.how_these_came_to_light: The paper's own methods and results section, which was already in the local corpus and which this contract should have quoted before asserting anything about the preparation. Published prose is not a reserved observation and reading it cost nothing; not reading it cost two wrong facts.

correction_1_the_recordings_are_minimal_.what_was_written: This contract, ADR-2026-012 and the intake all described the Figure 3 recordings as compound evoked responses to stimulation of the ORN axon bundle, inferred from the eEPSC label in the authors' plotting code.
correction_1_the_recordings_are_minimal_.what_the_paper_says: 'eEPSCs were evoked by stimulating ORN axons with a minimal stimulation protocol via a suction electrode.' Minimal stimulation is the standard method for isolating a single-fibre response, which is the opposite of compound.
correction_1_the_recordings_are_minimal_.consequence_for_the_observation_model: The saturation term of VAL-02 loses most of its force for these data. Minimal stimulation produces small responses precisely to stay off the saturating part of the postsynaptic curve, so the upward bias that would otherwise be the leading alternative explanation of a measured ratio above the prediction is weak here. The failure is therefore MORE attributable to the model than the amended VAL-02 would allow in general. VAL-02 itself is unchanged and its two-directional account stands; what changes is its weight in this particular case.
correction_1_the_recordings_are_minimal_.consequence_for_the_10_ms_interval: The overlap problem at 10 ms is not unhandled after all. The paper states that 'the amplitude of the second response in 10 ms inter-pulse recordings was measured from the peak to the point of interception with the extrapolated first response', which is an explicit correction for the decay of the first response. The justification for 100 ms being primary therefore rests on the stronger reason alone: it is the interval the registry's prediction was written for at fb01944.
correction_1_the_recordings_are_minimal_.consequence_for_the_retired_synaptic_leg: The leg STAYS RETIRED and the gate stays at v4 and 0 of 3, but the reason must be restated. It is not that the recordings are compound; they are minimal-stimulation unitary responses. It is that the staged repository ships per-animal scalars and per-animal averaged amplitudes, not the unitary WAVEFORMS the leg needs: Figure 3 holds paired-pulse ratios and 32-pulse amplitude series, and the only raw traces in the repository, Figure 1's IAA_IC and IAA_VC, are odour-evoked whole-cell recordings rather than minimal-stimulation eEPSCs. A kinetics holdout scoring peak time and decay without peak alignment cannot be built from scalars. If the authors' unitary waveforms became available the condition would be met, and that is a sharper and more useful statement than the one it replaces.

correction_2_the_orientation_was_never_r.the_gap: This contract named the file, the variable, the metric and the limit, and did not name the orientation of the ratio. Under the standard convention PPR is the second response over the first; under the inverse the interval ordering would flip and H3 would have passed. That was a real preregistration gap and scoring it either way would have been a choice made after the data were in hand.
correction_2_the_orientation_was_never_r.how_it_is_settled_without_spending_anyth: The paper's results section states that 'cac knockdown led to increased paired-pulse FACILITATION at short inter-pulse intervals', and its figure legends repeat it for all three cohorts. Facilitation means a second response larger than the first, so the arrays are second over first, values above one are facilitation, and the orientation this run scored is the authors' own.
correction_2_the_orientation_was_never_r.what_it_changes: Nothing in the numbers, and it removes the one reading under which H3 would have passed. The observed wild-type facilitation at short intervals is the paper's own finding rather than an artifact of how this project read the arrays.
